The club competes in [[2. Liga (Austria)|Austrian 2. Liga]], the second tier of the Austrian football. Founded in 1919, it is affiliated to the [[Vorarlberg Football Association]]. The team plays its home matches at [[Casino Stadium|ImmoAgentur Stadion]], where it has been based since 1951. The club's history includes numerous [[Promotion and relegation|promotions and relegations]] and some spells of sustained success, including participation in the [[UEFA Intertoto Cup]] in [[2002 UEFA Intertoto Cup|2002]] and [[2004 UEFA Intertoto Cup|2004]]. The club went bankrupt in 2005 and was subsequently refounded. [[File:SC Bregenz3.jpg|thumb|Part of the squad before the away match versus Red Bull Juniors Salzburg]]"}}
